rows.label: tlk70000045_01_msg0001
rows.name:
Rikoko decided to become a traveling
performer, mo! But how does one become
a traveling performer, mo?

rows.label: tlk70000045_01_msg0002
rows.name:
I'll have to ask those people after
all, mo~.

rows.label: tlk70000045_01_msg0003
rows.name:
Mo? By those people, I mean the
traveling performers Leon and Azzaro,
of course, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000045_01_msg0004
rows.name:
Those two are traveling performers who
are becoming popular in Iira, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000045_01_msg0005
rows.name:
Someday Rikoko wants to become a
traveling performer like those two,
mo!
